name: pr-review-hub
description: Multi-team local web cockpit and continuously learning AI code review agent (my-review) for GitHub Pull Requests.

scripts.doctor: node --input-type=module -e "import { loadConfig } from './ui/lib/config.mjs'; import { runDoctor } from './ui/lib/doctor.mjs'; const r = await runDoctor(loadConfig()); for (const c of r.checks) console.log((c.ok ? '🟢' : '🔴'), c.label, '—', c.detail);"
